name: The Tall Grass
intro: The path gives up halfway and becomes grass taller than you are.
outro: The grass thins. Ahead, the road, and past the road, the first real slope.

nodes.label: The Edge of It
nodes.text: Something moves alongside you and does not show itself.

nodes.label: Push In
nodes.text: Head down. It is only grass.

nodes.label: Keep Going
nodes.text: Halfway is the worst place to stop and you know it.

nodes.label: A Different Shape
nodes.text: Something is aching. Give it a rest and work something else.

nodes.label: All The Way Through
nodes.text: One more and you are out the other side.

nodes.label: The Road Again
nodes.text: You are out, and slightly cut about the forearms, and pleased about it.
